verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the 'guided path' feature on the Fireworks marketing page describing a wizard that lets a user describe a fine-tuning task, review a plan/cost, and approve the run to get a trained model — a thin form of task delegation to an automated system, not a general-purpose built-in assistant integrated across the product. Missing for 10: no docs on a persistent in-product chat/assistant UI, no evidence of assistant capabilities beyond fine-tuning setup, no independent/hands-on confirmation of this guided-path feature working.
